project_type: Python monorepo: RAG chatbot with Telegram bot, API, ingestion pipeline
build_system: uv (pyproject.toml, uv.lock). No custom build step; uses uv sync for deps.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, pytest-xdist (parallel). Tests in tests/unit/, tests/integration/, tests/contract/. Fixtures in conftest.py files.
build_command: uv sync && uv run ruff check src/ telegram_bot/
test_command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/ --ignore=tests/unit/test_document_parser.py --ignore=tests/unit/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/unit/evaluation/test_ragas_evaluation.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_sip_setup.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_voice_agent.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_cocoindex_init.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_helpers.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_state_paths.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_target_sync_execution.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_cli.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow_wiring.py -n auto --dist=worksteal -q --timeout=30 -m 'not legacy_api and not requires_extras and not slow'
verification_instructions: 1. Run `uv run ruff check src/ telegram_bot/` (lint). 2. Run `make test-unit` (core unit tests). 3. Verify no `from telegram_bot` imports remain in src/ files (except src/api/main.py for graph/cache which is out of scope). 4. Verify telegram_bot/ re-exports still work for existing consumers.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.12 recommended. No Docker daemon needed for unit tests.
contribution_requirements: Create branch from dev. Run `make check` and `make test-unit` before claiming completion. Test-first workflow per AGENTS.md.
key_patterns: 1. Lazy imports used extensively (telegram_bot/services/__init__.py pattern). 2. Observability uses langfuse SDK with graceful degradation (no-op when unavailable). 3. _retry.py provides shared retry decorators. 4. src/ is the domain layer, telegram_bot/ is the transport layer. 5. Tests patch modules at their import location (e.g. patch 'src.ingestion.unified.observability.get_client').
directory_structure: src/ - domain layer (api/, config/, core/, contextualization/, evaluation/, ingestion/, models/, retrieval/, security/, utils/, voice/). telegram_bot/ - transport/bot layer (agents/, graph/, handlers/, integrations/, services/, middlewares/, pipelines/). tests/ - test suites (unit/, integration/, contract/, smoke/, load/, e2e/, benchmark/). services/ - standalone microservices (bge-m3-api/, docling/, user-base/).
